{"path":"snake_anthropic-claude-sonnet-5_01.html","edit_description":"Create a complete, self-contained classic Snake game as a single HTML file (HTML+CSS+JS all inline, no external dependencies). Requirements:

GRID & RENDERING
- 30x30 grid rendered on an HTML canvas, each cell ~18-20px, canvas centered on page.
- Dark themed UI with clear contrasting colors for snake(s), food, and grid background.

CORE GAMEPLAY
- Snake moves continuously in one of four directions (up/down/left/right) at a fixed tick interval (e.g. setInterval or requestAnimationFrame with timing accumulator, ~120-150ms per tick).
- Snake cannot reverse directly into itself (ignore input that reverses current direction).
- Eating food grows the snake by one segment and increases score; spawn new food at a random empty cell (not on any snake body).
- Game ends (for a snake) if it hits a wall (goes outside 0..29 grid bounds) or collides with its own body or, in two-snake modes, the other snake's body (head-on collisions and hitting the other snake's body both end the game for the colliding snake). Handle head-to-head collision as both dying (draw) or as appropriate.
- Score displayed live during gameplay in a HUD area above/below the canvas, showing score for each active snake with labels (e.g. "Player: 5" / "CPU: 3").

GAME MODES (selectable from a start menu)
1. Human vs Human: two snakes, Player 1 controlled with Arrow keys, Player 2 controlled with W/A/S/D keys. Two separate snakes and scores on screen simultaneously; last snake alive wins, or if both die same tick it's a draw.
2. CPU vs Human: one snake controlled by human (Arrow keys), one snake controlled by AI.
3. CPU vs CPU: both snakes controlled by AI automatically (fully automated, spectator mode).
- In single-context modes just one food item shared on the board; both snakes race for it.

CPU AI
- Implement a pathfinding-based AI (e.g., BFS shortest path on the grid from the CPU snake's head to the food, avoiding walls and both snakes' current body cells) that picks the next move direction toward the food.
- If no path to food exists, fall back to a safe move heuristic (choose a direction that keeps the most open space / avoids immediate collision, e.g. simple flood-fill scoring of the 3 candidate directions excluding reverse) so CPU doesn't just crash immediately.
- AI recomputes path every tick (or when needed) based on current state.

UI / SCREENS
- Start menu screen (shown on load) with a title "Snake" and three buttons/options to choose the mode: "Human vs Human", "CPU vs Human", "CPU vs CPU". Also mention keyboard controls in the menu (Arrows for Player 1 / CPU-vs-Human human player, WASD for Player 2 in Human vs Human).
- Game over screen overlay shown when the round ends: display final score(s), a message indicating winner ("Player 1 Wins!", "CPU Wins!", "Draw!", etc. depending on mode/labels used), and instruction "Press any key or Enter to play again" / "Press M to return to menu".
- Support restarting the game via a keypress (e.g. Enter or Space) directly from the game-over screen, restarting the SAME mode. Also support pressing a key (e.g. "M") to go back to the start menu to pick a different mode.
- Use semantic, clean layout: a container div, canvas element with id, HUD div with score spans, overlay divs for menu and game-over that are shown/hidden via CSS classes (display:none / flex) and toggled by JS.

CODE STRUCTURE
- All in one file: <style> in <head>, game markup in <body>, all JavaScript in one <script> tag at the end of body, wrapped in an IIFE or DOMContentLoaded listener, no build tools, no external libraries, must run by opening the file directly in a browser.
- Use requestAnimationFrame game loop with delta-time accumulation for consistent tick speed across devices.
- Prevent default browser scrolling behavior for arrow keys and WASD via keydown event.preventDefault().
- Include clear comments explaining state machine (menu -> playing -> gameover), the snake data model (array of {x,y} segments + direction), collision detection, food spawning, and the BFS AI pathfinding function.
- Keep code well organized with clearly separated sections: constants/config, state, rendering functions, input handling, AI logic, update/tick logic, and initialization.

Produce the full valid HTML5 document (doctype, html, head with title "Snake Game", meta charset, style block, body with menu/game/gameover sections, script block)."}
